title: Sbumbu Road, Amaoti, Inanda (map point estimated): two men shot dead, one wounded by two gunmen; murder cases, suspects sought, 25 Oct
summary: Police say three men were walking on Sbumbu Road in Amaoti, Inanda, north of Durban, on the morning of Sunday 25 October when two men emerged and fired at them. Two of the three died and the third was taken to a clinic. ...
story: Police say three men were walking on Sbumbu Road in Amaoti, Inanda, north of Durban, on the morning of Sunday 25 October when two men emerged and fired at them. Two of the three died and the third was taken to a clinic. KwaZulu-Natal police spokesperson Paul Magwaza said police are investigating two cases of murder and one of attempted murder (via East Coast Radio). Reaction Unit South Africa, a private response unit, said the shooting followed a robbery that morning: one of the victims had reportedly gone back with two friends to confront the robbery suspects, who allegedly opened fire. A manhunt was under way; no arrest has been reported. The victims are not named here. One public report: East Coast Radio, 26 October. The map point is estimated: Sbumbu Road could not be found on a map, so the pin is a point in Amaoti, not the road.
incident: Sun 25 Oct 2026, morning (police and Reaction Unit South Africa, via East Coast Radio).
location_note: ESTIMATED MAP POINT. Sbumbu Road, Amaoti, Inanda, north of Durban (police, via East Coast Radio). Sbumbu Road was not found on a map (OpenStreetMap Overpass and Nominatim returned no Sbumbu feature). The pin is a point in Amaoti, near Amaoti Primary School on OpenStreetMap, used only as a reference for the area; it is not the road. Uncertainty about 2 km.
